title: Audit Log Pipeline TF Module: Cross-account CloudTrail -> OpenSearch + Retention & Archival
creator: Marco Ramirez
description: Create a reusable Terraform module that implements a hardened audit-log pipeline suitable for Private/VPC deployments. The module will provision a centralized CloudTrail (or attach to an existing multi-account CloudTrail), cross-account delivery to an encrypted S3 bucket, optional event log parsing/forwarding into OpenSearch (self-hosted in customer VPC or managed), and configurable retention/archival lifecycle policies. Goals: 1) single TF module customers can plug into their account to enable secure, auditable logging; 2) support zero-downtime migration from existing ad-hoc buckets; 3) parameterize retention (hot/warm/cold) and archival to Glacier/Deep Archive; 4) produce outputs for RBAC/audit teams and Console dashboards. Module must be opinionated but configurable: KMS key support, bucket access logging, bucket-owner enforced, metrics and alerting hooks (CloudWatch), IAM role assumptions for cross-account CloudTrail aggregation, OpenSearch index templates and Index Lifecycle Management (ILM) policies, automated snapshots for long-term retention, and health-check endpoints for CI/CD verification.
acceptance_criteria: Terraform module published in private registry with version v0.1.0 and semantic versioning
Module provisions encrypted S3 bucket with bucket policies that enforce TLS, block public access, and enable access logging
Cross-account CloudTrail delivery role templates are generated and tested against a simulated 3-account setup
OpenSearch integration: index templates + ILM policies created; indices roll over by size (configurable, default 50GB) or age (default 30d)
S3 lifecycle transitions to Glacier/Deep Archive after configurable window and supports retention lock via retention_days parameter
Module exposes outputs for key resources (bucket_arn, cloudtrail_delivery_role_arn, opensearch_ilm_policy_name, snapshot_repo_name) and docs show migration steps for alias switchover
Automated integration test runs in CI: deploy to sandbox AWS account, ingest synthetic CloudTrail events, validate index creation, ILM rollover, and snapshot creation
Security review completed and module passes least-privilege IAM checks and KMS usage policy
tasks: Design TF API: inputs (enable_cloudtrail, existing_bucket, kms_key_id, retention_days, rollover_size_gb, rollover_days, archive_to_glacier) and outputs
Implement S3 bucket TF with server-side encryption, bucket policy, and access logging
Implement CloudTrail attachment + cross-account role templates and example usage in docs
Add OpenSearch resources: role, index_template, ilm_policy, snapshot_repository (S3), and optional ingest pipeline mapping
Write migration guide for existing buckets to adopt module with alias-based index swap and reindexing notes
Add automated acceptance tests (Terratest/Python) to CI and a lightweight healthcheck that queries OpenSearch cluster state
Run security review and update module to address feedback (least-privilege, kms key policy, deny statements)
